tools.name: list_video_models
tools.description: List available video models and their capabilities. Video generation consumes credits; use get_video_model for detailed pricing and the values used when options are omitted.

tools.name: get_video_model
tools.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one video model. Each mode lists durations, resolutions, aspect_ratios, audio_toggle, credits, and defaults: the duration, resolution and aspect_ratio that generate_video sends and bills when you omit them. max_prompt_length is present when the model limi

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Create a video generation task and return its task_id. mode defaults to image-to-video when image_urls are given, else video-to-video when video_urls are given, else text-to-video. Omitted duration, resolution and aspect_ratio use the mode's defaults from get_video_model and are billed at those valu

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the current status, output URLs and cost_credits for one of the authenticated user's tasks (video, image, music, or audio). Failed and canceled tasks include error_code and error_message; their credits are refunded automatically.

tools.name: wait_for_task
tools.description: Wait up to timeout_seconds (1-50, default 45) for a task and return its latest status in the get_task shape. Some videos take several minutes: keep calling wait_for_task until status is success, failed, or canceled. Task results are persisted and never lost.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's remaining credits. Generation consumes credits.

tools.name: list_image_models
tools.description: List available image models with their modes (text-to-image, image-to-image), aspect ratios, qualities, and credit labels. Image generation consumes credits.

tools.name: get_image_model
tools.description: Get full capabilities and credit pricing for one image model. Generating an image with this model consumes credits.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Create an image generation task (text-to-image, or image-to-image when image_urls are provided). Pro/Ultra flagship models (GPT Image 2, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2, Grok Imagine) and Ultra ViewMax C1 cost 0 credits within the shared daily fair-use pool; otherwise this consumes credits. tools.name: list_music_models
tools.description: List available music models and their controls (duration, instrumental) and credit cost. Music costs 60 credits for tracks up to 60 seconds, then 1 credit per second.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Create an original music track from a text prompt. Costs 60 credits for tracks up to 60 seconds, then 1 credit per second (duration_seconds defaults to 60); plan allowances do not cover music. tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List available text-to-speech voices (id, name, gender, accent, language) and speech pricing: characters_per_credit and minimum_credits. A generation costs ceil(characters / 20) credits, minimum 1.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech with a selected voice_id (see list_voices). Costs ceil(characters / 20) credits, minimum 1. Speech renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

tools.name: generate_sound_effect
tools.description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt. Costs 5 credits. Renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_task · Public sink: generate_music.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_task · Public sink: generate_music

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
